# makio-meshline

> Thick lines and world-space road and ribbon surfaces for Three.js r186+ with `WebGPURenderer` (WebGPU, or its WebGL2 fallback): gradients, dashes, textures, shadows, instancing, TSL shader hooks, GPU storage-buffer positions, GPU picking and chunk culling. No dependency besides `three`.

Before writing makio-meshline code, read [llms-full.txt](https://meshline.makio.io/llms-full.txt): setup, rules, the full API, TSL hooks, tested recipes and a troubleshooting table in one file. The npm package ships the same file as `node_modules/makio-meshline/llms-full.txt`.

The rules behind most mistakes:
- Use `WebGPURenderer` from `'three/webgpu'` and `await renderer.init()`. `THREE.WebGLRenderer` cannot draw MeshLine.
- Option keys are the method names: `new MeshLine( { lineWidth: 0.2 } )` equals `new MeshLine().lineWidth( 0.2 )`. Unknown keys warn.
- `lineWidth` is in world units by default (0.3); `.sizeAttenuation( false )` makes it CSS pixels.
- Hooks are plain functions, `( color, progress ) => …`, or `Fn( ( [color, progress] ) => … )`; never `Fn( ( color, progress ) => … )`.
- Animate with `.dynamic( true )` and `setPositions()`; never create lines per frame.
- `.surface()` lines are lit world-space meshes: the scene needs lights.

## Docs

- [Agent reference](https://meshline.makio.io/llms-full.txt): everything above in one file, kept in step with the source by tests
- [Getting Started](https://meshline.makio.io/guide.html): installation, `WebGPURenderer` setup and a first line
- [MeshLine API](https://meshline.makio.io/meshline.html): every fluent method and option
- [TSL Hooks](https://meshline.makio.io/hooks.html): shader hooks and their arguments
- [World-Space Surfaces](https://meshline.makio.io/surface.html): lit roads and ribbons, frames, banking, joins and caps
- [Helpers and Storage Buffers](https://meshline.makio.io/helpers.html): point generators and `storagePositions`
- [GPU Picking](https://meshline.makio.io/picking.html): `MeshLinePicker` and `MeshLinePickerHelper`
- [React Three Fiber](https://meshline.makio.io/react-three-fiber.html): a declarative `<MeshLine>` wrapper to copy
- [Vue](https://meshline.makio.io/vue.html): a declarative `<MeshLine>` wrapper for Vue 3 and TresJS
- [Performance](https://meshline.makio.io/performance.html): batching, instancing and vertex-buffer budgets

## Optional

- [MeshLineGeometry](https://meshline.makio.io/meshline-geometry.html): buffer layout, `setPositions` and `setPositionRange`
- [MeshLineNodeMaterial](https://meshline.makio.io/meshline-material.html): material uniforms and hooks
- [GPU Culling](https://meshline.makio.io/gpu-culling.html): chunk frustum culling into one indirect draw
- [Experimental GPU Path](https://meshline.makio.io/gpu-path.html): point-centric WebGPU path with simplification
- [V2 Benchmarks](https://meshline.makio.io/benchmarks.html): performance diagrams and benchmark results
- [V2 Migration Guide](https://meshline.makio.io/v2-migration.html): upgrading from v1
